_meta.non_oauth_substitution_note: Tock issues per-businessId API keys via integrate@tockhq.com under the Premium / Premium Unlimited tier commercial agreement (docs/integrations/tock/oauth_shape.md). API keys do not expire on a documented schedule; Tock revokes on commercial-relationship change (operator off-boards, Premium-tier downgrade). The framework's oauth_refresh_cron has NO closure for Tock — there is no token to refresh. The analog rotation path is: vendor 401 -> adapter flips connector_connection.status to 'error' -> operator re-pastes a new key into the F&F admin's vendor connections widget -> the framework persists the new key in vendor_credentials (HP #7).
_meta.phase_2_adapter_assertion: On 401 response from any TockApiClient method, the framework wrapping the adapter call MUST flip connector_connection.status to 'error' and surface 're-paste your Tock API key' chrome. The adapter itself does NOT own this transition — the framework's connector_status_service does, on receiving the typed exception from the transport.
_meta.phase_3_load_assertion: OAuth-refresh storm load lane (3C) MUST treat Tock as out-of-scope for refresh load — the refresh worker has no Tock closure registered. The lane confirms by introspecting the worker's per-vendor closure registry and asserting tock NOT IN registry.
